shortcut_probe.verdict: The probe is uncomfortable. Removing the brain costs the model something, but not much, so part of the score is being carried by features outside the brain.

cam_ventricle_overlap.region_area: matched per slice to the ventricle mask
cam_ventricle_overlap.cam_resolution_note: CAM is computed at the backbone final feature resolution (5x5 for a 160px input) then bilinearly upsampled, so it is inherently coarse. That bounds how high Dice can go regardless of alignment.
cam_ventricle_overlap.verdict: Trained CAM does NOT beat the controls, its apparent focus on the ventricles is explained by centre bias, not learned anatomy.
